On a failed save, it takes {@dice 5d6} psychic damage, and until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends, you cause a creature to regard all other beings as horrid, alien entities. On a successful save, the target takes only half the initial damage and suffers none of the other effects. An affected creature must repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns. On a failure, the target takes {@dice 1d6} psychic damage per creature within 5 feet of it. On a success, the effect ends on the target.

{@b Vertigo (6 psi; conc., 1 min.)} As an action, choose one creature you can see within 60 feet of you. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature becomes {@condition Poisoned|phb} until your concentration ends. While {@condition Poisoned|phb} in this way, at the start of each of their turns, they must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or they become {@condition Incapacitated|phb} from nausea until the start of their next turn. Additionally, any time the creature attempts to move 5 feet or stand up, they must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or they are knocked {@condition Prone|phb} after they move. At the end of each of their turns, they can remake the Wisdom saving throw, ending the effect on themselves on a success.

{@b World of Abhorrence (7 psi; conc., 1 min.)} As an action, choose up to six creatures within 60 feet of you. Each target must make an Intelligence saving throw. A creature automatically succeeds if it is immune to being {@condition Frightened|phb}. On a failed save, a target takes {@dice 8d6} psychic damage, and it is {@condition Frenzied|THICC} until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage. While {@condition Frenzied|THICC} by this effect, a target’s speed is reduced to 0, and the target can use its action, and any bonus action it might have, only to make melee attacks. The {@condition Frenzied|THICC} target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

optionalfeature.name: Crown of Fear
entries: {@i Avatar Discipline}
You tap into a well of primal fear and turn yourself into a beacon of terror to your enemies.

items: {@b Psychic Focus.} While focused on this discipline, you add 1d4 to the result of any Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) checks made by you.

{@b Incite Flight (1—7 psi)} As an action, choose one creature you can see within 60 feet of you. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or take {@dice 1d8} psychic damage per psi point spent. The save automatically succeeds if the target is immune to being {@condition Frightened|phb}. The target must then immediately use its reaction, if available, to move as far as its speed allows away from you. The creature doesn't move into obviously dangerous ground, such as a fire or a pit. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and doesn't have to move away.

{@b Incite Fear (2—7 psi; conc., 1 min.)} As an action, choose one creature you can see within 60 feet of you. You may target another creature per additional psi point spent. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition Frightened} of you until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends. The {@condition Frightened} target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns. This ability has no effect on undead or constructs.

{@b Unsettling Aura (5 psi; conc., 1 min.)} As a bonus action, you cloak yourself in unsettling psychic energy. Until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends, any enemy within 60 feet of you that can see you must spend 1 extra foot of movement for every foot it moves toward you. A creature ignores this effect if immune to being {@condition Frightened|phb}.

{@b Manifest Nightmare (6—7 psi; conc., 1 min.)} As an action, choose one creature within 120 feet of you, forcing it to make an Intelligence saving throw as you force it to witness its worst fear. On a failed save, the target takes {@dice 4d10} psychic damage and becomes {@condition Frightened|phb} of an illusion that you manifest in any space until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends. You can increase the damage by {@dice 1d10} per additional psi point spent on it. The illusion may occupy any space within the spell’s range, including those occupied by another creature, as the illusion will justify its own existence there. While {@condition Frightened|phb} in this way, the creature must remake the saving throw at the end of each of its turns. If they fail the saving throw, they once again take the damage and you may choose a new space for the illusion to occupy. On a successful save, the target recognizes what it is perceiving as not reality, steeling its mind to the delusion, and thus ending the effect on the creature.

{@b Incite Panic (7 psi; conc., 1 min.} As an action, choose up to eight creatures you can see within 90 feet of you that can see you. At the start of each of a target’s turns before your {@status concentration||concentration} ends, the target must make a Wisdom saving throw. A target makes the saving throw at disadvantage if the creature has disadvantage on saving throws against being {@condition Frenzied|THICC}. On a failed save, the target is {@condition Frightened|phb} until the start of its next turn, and you roll a die. If you roll an even number, the {@condition Frightened|phb} target makes one melee attack against a random target within its reach. If there is no such target or if you roll an odd number, the @condition Frightened|phb} target moves half its speed in a random direction and takes no action on that turn, other than to scream in terror. This effect ends on a target if it succeeds on a saving throw against it. This ability has no effect on undead or constructs.

optionalfeature.name: Crown of Rage
entries: {@i Avatar Discipline}
You place a mote of pure fury within a creature’s mind, causing its bloodlust to overcome its senses and for it to act as you wish it to.

items: {@b Psychic Focus.} While you are focused on this discipline, your taunts can be extremely distracting to enemies. As a bonus action, you target one creature within 30 feet of you. The target must succeed a Wisdom saving throw or have disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures other than you. On a success, the creature is immune to the effects of this focus for 24 hours.

{@b Primal Fury (1—7 psi)} As an action, choose one creature you can see within 60 feet of you. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or take {@dice 1d6} psychic damage per psi point spent on this ability and immediately use its reaction to move its speed in a straight line toward its nearest enemy. The target makes the saving throw at disadvantage if the creature has disadvantage on saving throws against being {@condition Frenzied|THICC}. The save automatically succeeds if the target is immune to being {@condition Charmed|phb} or {@condition Frenzied|THICC}.

{@b Fighting Words (2 psi; conc., 10 min.)} If you spend 1 minute conversing with a creature, you can attempt to leave a simmering violence in its mind. At the end of the minute, you can use an action to force the creature to make a Wisdom saving throw to resist feeling violent urges against one creature you describe to it or name. The target makes the saving throw at disadvantage if the creature has disadvantage on saving throws against being {@condition Frenzied|THICC}. The save automatically succeeds if the target is immune to being {@condition Charmed|phb} or {@condition Frenzied|THICC}. On a failed save, the target attacks the chosen creature if it sees that creature before your {@status concentration||concentration} ends, using weapons or spells against a creature it was already hostile toward or unarmed strikes against an ally or a creature it was neutral toward. Once the fight starts, it continues to attack for 5 rounds before this effect ends. This effect immediately ends if the target or any ally it can see is attacked or takes damage from any creature other than the one it has been incited against. On a successful save, the creature is unaffected and has no inkling of your attempt to bend its will, but it may think less of you depending on its personality.

{@b Mindless Courage (2 psi)} You cause a creature's bloodlust to overcome its sense of preservation. As a bonus action, choose one creature you can see within 60 feet of you. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or, until the end of your next turn, it can’t willingly move unless its movement brings it closer to its nearest enemy that it can see. The target makes the saving throw at disadvantage if the creature has disadvantage on saving throws against being {@condition Frenzied|THICC}. The save automatically succeeds if the target is immune to being {@condition Charmed|phb} or {@condition Frenzied|THICC}.

{@b Punishing Fury (7 psi; conc., 1 min.} You cause a creature's rage to grow so hot that it attacks without heeding its own safety. As a bonus action, choose one creature you can see within 60 feet of you. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or, until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends, any creature within 5 feet of it can use a reaction to make an attack of opportunity against it whenever the target makes a melee attack. The target makes the saving throw at disadvantage if the creature has disadvantage on saving throws against being {@condition Frenzied|THICC}. The save automatically succeeds if the target is immune to being {@condition Charmed|phb} or {@condition Frenzied|THICC}.

optionalfeature.name: Cryokinesis
entries: {@i Wu Jen Discipline}
You master the power of ice, shaping it to meet you demands.

items: {@b Psychic Focus.} While focused on this discipline, any cold damage you take is reduced by 3.

{@b Ice Spike (1—7 psi)} As an action, you hurl a mote of ice at one creature you can see within 120 feet of you, making a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes {@dice 1d12} cold damage per psi point spent and has its speed halved until the start of your next turn.

{@b Frozen Sanctuary (1—7 psi)} As an action, you sheathe yourself with icy resilience. You encase yourself in a cocoon of ice that has 12 AC, 10 hit points of each psi spent on this ability, and vulnerability to fire. Whenever you take damage, the cocoon takes the damage instead. If this damage reduces the cocoon to 0 hit points, you take any remaining damage. While it is active you are {@condition Incapacitated} and your speed is reduced to zero. Once per turn on each of your turns, you may spend a free action to heal the cocoon with psi points (up to your psi limit) healing it 10 hit points per psi point spent. You can’t heal it more than the initial hit points it had at its creation. The cocoon disappears after 8 hours or when you dismiss it as a free action at the end of your turn.

{@b Ice Sheet (1—7 psi)} As an action, choose a point on the ground you can see within 60 feet of you. The ground in a 5-foot per psi point spent square centered on that point becomes covered in ice, becoming {@quickref difficult terrain||3} for 1 minute. When the ice sheet appears, each creature standing in its area must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or fall {Condition Prone}. Any time a creature moves into or within the area, that creature must make the same save or they fall {@condition Prone} while they move. A creature trying to stand up must make the save or else they spend half their movement fumbling around. If the surface is sloped, a creature that fails a Dexterity saving throw against the ice sheet immediately slides in the direction of the bottom of the slope to the end of the ice sheet, if no creature or object prevents it from doing so by blocking the path of its forced movement.

{@b Snap Freeze (5—7 psi; conc., 1 min.)} As an action, choose a point you can see within 120 feet of you. The air in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point becomes deathly cold and saturated with moisture. Each creature in that area must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes {@dice 6d6} cold damage, and its speed is reduced to 0 until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage. As an action, a target that has its speed reduced can end the effect early if it succeeds on a Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check with a DC equal to this effect’s save DC. You can increase this effect’s damage by {@dice 1d6} per each additional psi point spent on it.

{@b Ice Barrier (6—7 psi; conc., 10 min.)} As an action, you create a wall of ice, at least one portion of which must be within 60 feet of you. The wall is 60 feet long, 15 feet high, and 1 foot thick. The wall lasts until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends. Each 10-foot section of the wall has AC 12 and 10 hit points per psi point spent, and is vulnerable to fire damage. A creature that damages the wall with a melee attack within 5 feet of the wall takes {@dice 1d8} cold damage.

{@b Animate Ice (7 psi; conc., 1 hr.)} As an action, you cause an ice elemental to appear in an unoccupied space filled with ice that you can see within 120 feet of you. The elemental lasts until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends, and it obeys your verbal commands. In combat, roll for its initiative, and choose its behavior during its turns. When this effect ends, the elemental disappears. The DM has their stat block.

optionalfeature.name: Diminution
entries: {@i Immortal Discipline}
You manipulate the matter that composes your body, drastically reducing your size without surrendering any of your might.

items: {@b Psychic Focus.} While focused on this discipline, if you are a Medium creature, you lose just enough height to become a Small creature at 4’11”. Otherwise, you decrease by 1 foot in height to a minimum of 2’6”. In either case, the decrease in height is proportional across your body.

{@b Toppling Shift (2 psi)} As a bonus action, you become Tiny until the end of your current turn. While Tiny in this way, you can move through the space of any Medium or larger creature as {@quickref difficult terrain||3}. If a up to one size larger than you is in your space when you suddenly return to normal, you force them to make a Strength save. On a failure, it is knocked {@condition Prone|phb} and moved 5 feet to an unoccupied space adjacent to you of your choice. If no such space exists, it remains in your space, causing the two of you to potentially be {@condition Squeezed|THICC}. On a success, the creature is not knocked {@condition Prone|phb} and instead forces you into an unoccupied space of the DM’s choosing. If no such space exists, you remain in its space, causing the two of you to potentially be {@condition Squeezed|THICC}.

{@b Miniature Form (3 psi; conc., 10 min.)} As a bonus action, you become Tiny until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends. While this size, you gain advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks to hide from creatures larger than Tiny and can move through gaps up to 6 inches across without being {@condition Squeezed|THICC}.

{@b Sudden Shift (6 psi)} As a reaction when you are hit by an attack, you shift down to minute size to avoid the attack. The attack misses, and you move up to 5 feet without provoking opportunity attacks before returning to normal size.

{@b Microscopic Form (7 psi; conc., 10 min.} As a bonus action, you become smaller than Tiny until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends. While this size, you gain advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks and a +5 bonus to AC, you can move through gaps up to 1 inch across without being {@condition Squeezed|THICC}, and you can’t make weapon attacks.

optionalfeature.name: Electrokinesis
entries: {@i Wu Jen Discipline}
You master your mind’s electricity, shaping it to meet your demands.

items: {@b Psychic Focus.} While focused on this discipline, any lightning damage you take is reduced by 3.

{@b Hurl Lightning (1—7 psi)} As an action, you throw a bolt of lightning at one creature you can see within 60 feet of you. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. If the target is wearing armor made of metal, this attack roll is made at advantage. On a hit, the target takes {@dice 2d6} lightning damage per psi point spent.

{@b Nerve Spike (1—7 psi)} As an action, you cause electricity to zap from your mind to the minds of intelligent creatures around you. Choose a number of creatures per psi point spent within 30 feet of you. For each target, if the target has an Intelligence score of 4 or greater, they take {@dice 1d6} lightning damage.

{@b Channel Lightning (2—7 psi; conc., 1 min.)} As an action, a beam of crackling, blue energy lances out toward a creature you can see within the ability’s range, forming a sustained arc of lightning between you and the target. The range of this ability is 30 feet, but you can increase it by 10 feet per additional psi point spent. Make a ranged spell attack against that target. If the target is wearing armor made of metal, this attack roll is made at advantage. On a hit, the target takes {@dice 1d12} lightning damage, and on each of your turns until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends, you can use your action to deal {@dice 1d12} lightning damage to the target automatically. Your {@status concentration||concentration} ends if you use your action to do anything else. Your {@status concentration||concentration} also ends if the target is outside the ability’s range of it it has {@quickref Cover||3||total cover} from you.

{@b Energy Torrent (5—7 psi)} As an action, you let loose a burning line of violent energy that is 100 feet long and 5 feet wide. Each creature in the line must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@dice 4d6} lightning damage, {@dice 2d6} fire damage, and {@dice 2d6} force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. You can increase the width of the line by 5 feet per additional psi point spent. The line ignites flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried. Any creatures or objects Overkilled by this ability are disintegrated. A disintegrated creature and everything it is wearing and carrying, except magic items, are reduced to a pile of fine gray dust. Disintegrated creatures can be restored to life only by means of a {@spell True Resurrection|COOMS} or a {@spell Wish|PHB} spell.

{@b Electric Current (6—7 psi)} As an action, you shoot a stream of lightning that flows from one target of your choice within 60 feet to another. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or else they take {@dice 5d8} lightning damage as electricity jolts through them. The stream then arcs to a different target of your choice within 30 feet of the most recent target. The new target must then succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or they suffer {@dice 5d8} lightning damage and trigger the same effect as the original target. You do not need to see the target for the stream to arc to them, but you need to know of their existence. Per manifestation of the ability, the stream of lightning may only hit a maximum of 5 creatures or objects in total, and may not target the same creature twice. You may spend an additional psi point to increase the maximum total number of targets to 6. If a creature ever succeeds the saving throw, they take half damage and the ability ends. If the ability ever deals no damage to a creature or targets a creature outside of the reach that the lightning can jump to, the ability ends.

{@b Volt Tackle (7 psi)} As an action, you transform yourself into pure neural electricity and hurl yourself at a foe. Choose a creature directly adjacent to an unoccupied space that you can see within 90 feet of yourself. The target and every creature in a line to them must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@dice 4d6} lightning damage on a failed save, and half as much on a success. You then make a melee spell attack against the target as you approach them. You have advantage on the attack roll if the target is wearing armor made of metal. On a hit, the target takes {@dice 8d6} lightning damage and is {@condition Stunned} until the end of your next turn. Finally, you move to the previously chosen unoccupied space adjacent to your target as the transform ends.

{@b System Overload (7 psi; conc., 1 min.)} As an action, you attempt to grab a creature within 5 feet of yourself to overload them with electric energy. The target must make a Dexterity saving throw. If the target is wearing armor made of metal, this saving throw is made at disadvantage. On a failure, the target takes {@dice 12d6} lightning damage and is knocked {@condition Prone} and {@condition Stunned} until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends as their body starts to violently seize. On a success, the target takes half as much damage and is not {@condition Stunned} or knocked {@condition Prone}. At the end of each of the {@condition Stunned} target’s turns, they must make a Constitution saving throw, taking {@dice 2d6} lightning damage on a failed save and ending the effect on a success.

optionalfeature.name: Giant Growth
entries: {@i Immortal Discipline}
You infuse yourself with psionic energy to grow to tremendous size, bolstering your strength and durability.

items: {@b Psychic Focus.} While focused on this discipline, if you are a Small creature, you gain just enough height to become a Medium creature at 5’0”. Otherwise, you increase by 1 foot in height to a maximum of 8’0”. In either case, the increase in height is proportional across your body.
{@b Extend (1 psi)} As a bonus action, you can increase your reach by 5 feet for the rest of your turn.

{@b Growth Spurt (2 psi)} As a reaction to when you fail a grapple, shove, or disarm contest, you can temporarily count as one size larger for the purposes of the contest, potentially turning the failure into a success.

{@b Ogre Form (3 psi; conc., 1 min.)} As a bonus action, you gain 10 temporary hit points. In addition, until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends, your melee weapon attacks deal an extra {@dice 1d4} damage on a hit, and your reach increases by 5 feet. If you’re smaller than Large, you also become Large for the duration.

{@b Giant Form (7 psi; conc., 1 min.} As a bonus action, you gain 30 temporary hit points. In addition, until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends, your melee weapon attacks deal an extra {@dice 2d6} damage die on a hit, and your reach increases by 10 feet. If you’re smaller than Huge, you also become Huge for the duration.

optionalfeature.name: Hydrokinesis
entries: {@i Wu Jen Discipline}
Your mind becomes one with elemental water, attuning your thoughts to its ebb and flow.

items: {@b Psychic Focus.} While focused on this discipline, you have advantage on checks made to {@action Swim|THICC}.
{@b Create Water (1—7 psi)} As an action, you create up to 10 gallons of clean water per psi point spent within 30 feet of yourself in an open container.

{@b Dessicate (1—7 psi)} As an action, choose one creature you can see within 60 feet of you. The target must make a Constitution saving throw, taking {@dice 1d10} necrotic damage per psi point spent on this ability, or half as much damage on a successful one. If you target a plant creature or a magical plant, it makes the saving throw with disadvantage.

{@b Tidal Grasp (2—7 psi)} As an action, you unleash a wave that surges forth and then retreats to you like the rising tide. You create a wave in a 20-foot-by-20-foot square. At least some portion of the square’s border must be within 5 feet of you. Any creature in that square must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes {@dice 1d6} bludgeoning damage, is knocked {@condition Prone}, and is pulled up to 10 feet closer to you. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage. You can increase this ability’s damage by {@dice 1d6} per additional psi point spent on it.

{@b Water Jet (3—7 psi)} As an action, you unleash a jet of water in a line that is 60 feet long and 5 feet wide. Each creature in the line must make a Strength saving throw, taking {@dice 3d6} bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. In addition, you can push each target that fails its saving throw up to 15 feet following the line. You can increase this ability’s damage by {@dice 1d6} per additional psi point spent on it.
{@b Water Breathing (5 psi)} As an action, you grant yourself and up to ten willing creatures you can see within 60 feet of you the ability to breathe underwater for the next 24 hours.

{@b Water Sphere (6 psi; conc., 1 min.)} As an action, you cause a sphere of water to form around a creature. Choose one creature you can see within 60 feet of you. The target must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, it becomes trapped in the sphere of water until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends. While the target is trapped, it is {@condition Submerged|THICC}, its speed is halved, it suffers the penalties of attacking with a weapon while underwater, and, if it can’t breathe underwater, it can’t see anything more than 10 feet away from it and it must hold its breath to avoid suffocation. However, attack rolls against it also suffer the penalties of attacking with a weapon while underwater. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a successful one.

{@b Animate Water (7 psi; conc., 1 hr.)} As an action, you cause a water elemental to appear in an unoccupied space filled with liquid water that you can see within 120 feet of you. The elemental lasts until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends, and it obeys your verbal commands. In combat, roll for its initiative, and choose its behavior during its turns. When this effect ends, the elemental disappears. The DM has their stat block.

optionalfeature.name: Instinctive Fighting
entries: {@i Soulknife Discipline}
You channel psionic power into your body, honing your reflexes to an incredible degree. You don’t give your foes time to react before they meet an extremely swift demise.

items: {@b Psychic Focus.} While focused on this discipline, you add 1d4 to the result of any Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks made by you.

{@b Swift Deflection (1—7 psi)} As a reaction, when you are hit by a melee attack or a ranged weapon attack, you give your body a burst of speed to deflect the attack away from yourself. You reduce the triggering attack’s damage by {@dice 2d4} per psi point spent plus your Intelligence modifier. If the incoming damage is from a melee attack and you completely negate the incoming damage, the attacker becomes {@condition Wide Open|THICC} as a result of this feature. If you negate the incoming damage by matching their damage roll exactly, the attacker is prevented from attacking for the remainder of their turn, ending an ongoing multiattack or series of attacks granted by the Extra Attack feature. If the incoming damage is from a ranged weapon attack and you completely negate the incoming damage, you can direct the attack to one creature within 5 feet of you, deflecting the missile to a nearby creature. If the attack roll would hit the creature, the creature takes damage equal to the remainder of the potential damage that you could have negated.

{@b Protective Reflexes (2 psi)} As a reaction when you are targeted as the recipient of a melee attack, you heighten your reflexes to strike at the opponent while they have their guard down. You make an Attack of Opportunity against your attacker before they make their attack, potentially causing them to be knocked unconscious before they can hit you.
{@b Surge of Action (3 psi)} As a bonus action, you can make one weapon attack or take the {@action Dash}, {@action Disengage}, {@action Hide}, or Use an Object action.

{@b Slice Through (5—7 psi)} As an action, you temporarily imbue yourself with a surge of psionic energy, allowing you to gain a burst of speed before enemies can react. Choose an unoccupied space within 30 feet of yourself. You instantly move to that space while making as many attacks as you can with a weapon in a given Attack action on every enemy in a line to that space. You can increase the distance you can travel by 10 feet per additional psi point spent on it.

{@b Flurry of Attacks (7 psi)} As an action, you seem to disappear from sight as you move throughout the battlefield. Choose up to 10 creatures within 30 feet of yourself. You may make a number of melee attacks against them equal to the number of times you can attack with a weapon in a given {@action Attack} action. You can then choose to teleport to an unoccupied space that you can see within 5 feet of one of the targets you attacked.

optionalfeature.name: Intellect Fortress
entries: {@i Awakened Discipline}
You forge an indomitable wall of psionic energy around your mind—one that allows you to launch counterattacks against your opponents.

items: {@b Psychic Focus.} While focused on this discipline, any psychic damage you take is reduced by 3.

{@b Psionic Shield (1—7 psi)} As a bonus action on one creature within 30 feet of you or as a reaction on yourself when you are targeted by the Psionic Blast feature of the Psychic Assault discipline, the target takes {@dice 1d6} less psychic damage from the Psionic Blast feature per psi point spent. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

{@b Psychic Backlash (1—7 psi)} When a creature you can see within 60 feet damages you or attempts to read your thoughts, as a reaction, you can force the creature to make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, the attacker takes {@dice 1d10} psychic damage per psi point spent, taking half as much on a success.
{@b Psychic Parry (1—7 psi)} As a reaction when you make an Intelligence, a Wisdom, or a Charisma saving throw, you gain a +1 bonus to that saving throw for each psi point you spend on this ability.

{@b Telepathic Protection (5 psi; conc., 1 hr.)} As a bonus action, until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends, you or one willing creature you can see within 60 feet of you can’t have their mind read or detected. You may target another creature per additional psi point spent. Additionally, creatures can’t telepathically communicate with the target unless the target allows it, and the target has advantage on saving throws against any effect that would determine whether or not it is telling the truth.

{@b Mind Shield (5 psi; conc., 1 hr.)} As a bonus action, until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends, you or one willing creature you can see within 60 feet of you has resistance to psychic damage, as well as advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

{@b Psychic Redoubt (7 psi; conc., 10 min.)} As an action, you create a field of protective psychic energy. Choose any number of creatures within 30 feet of you. Until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends, each target has resistance to psychic damage and advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

optionalfeature.name: Iron Durability
entries: {@i Immortal Discipline}
You transform your body to become a living metal, allowing you to shrug off attacks that would cripple weaker creatures.

items: {@b Psychic Focus.} While focused on this discipline, any bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage you take is reduced by 1.

{@b Iron Hide (1—7 psi)} As a reaction when you are hit by an attack, you gain a +1 bonus to AC for each psi point you spend on this ability. This bonus applies against the triggering attack and lasts until the end of your next turn.
{@b Steel Hide (2 psi)} As a bonus action, you gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage until the end of your next turn.

{@b Iron Resistance (7 psi; conc., 1 min.)} As an action, you gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage, and your AC can’t be less than 18, which lasts until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends.

optionalfeature.name: Mantle of Awe
entries: {@i Avatar Discipline}
You learn to use psionic energy to manipulate others with a subtle combination of psi and your own, natural charm.

items: {@b Psychic Focus.} While focused on this discipline, you add {@dice 1d4} to the result of any Charisma ({@skill Performance}) checks made by you.

{@b Charming Presence (1—7 psi)} As an action, you exert an aura of sympathetic power. Roll {@dice 3d10} per psi point spent on this ability; the total is how many hit points worth of creatures this option can affect. Creatures within 30 feet of you are affected in ascending order of their hit point maximums, ignoring {@condition Incapacitated|phb} creatures, creatures immune to being {@condition Charmed|phb}, and creatures engaged in combat. Starting with the creature that has the lowest hit point maximum, each creature affected by this option is {@condition Charmed|phb} by you for 10 minutes, regarding you as a friendly acquaintance. Subtract each creature’s hit point maximum from the total before moving on to the next creature. A creature’s hit point maximum must be equal to or less than the remaining total for that creature to be affected.

{@b Center of Attention (3 psi; conc., 1 min.)} As an action, you exert an aura of power that grabs a creature's attention. Choose one creature you can see within 60 feet of you. It must make a Wisdom saving throw. If you or creatures that are friendly to you are fighting it, it has advantage on the saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is so thoroughly distracted by you that all other creatures are {@condition Invisible|phb} to it until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends. This effect ends if the creature can no longer see or hear you, if it takes damage, or if the creature’s attention is forcibly taken away from it by another creature’s action or by being startled by something such as a loud noise.

{@b Favor (3 psi; conc., 8 hrs.)} As an action, you ask someone for a favor, which you define to be a course of activity (limited to a sentence or two) and psionically influence a creature you can see within 30 feet of you that can understand you. Creatures that can't be {@condition Charmed} are immune to this effect. The favor must be worded in such a manner as to make the course of action sound reasonable. Asking the creature to stab itself, throw itself onto a spear, immolate itself, or do some other obviously harmful act ends the ability. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it pursues the favor you described to the best of its ability. The favor can continue until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends. If the favor can be completed in a shorter time, the ability ends when the subject finishes what it was asked to do. You can also specify conditions that will trigger a special activity during the duration. For example, you might ask a knight to give her warhorse to the first beggar she meets as a favor to you. If the condition isn't met before the ability expires, the activity isn't performed. If you or any of your companions damage the target, the ability ends.

{@b Invoke Adoration (6—7 psi; conc., 1 hr.)} As an action, you attempt to charm a creature you can see within 30 feet of you. You may target another creature per additional psi point spent. It must make a Wisdom saving throw, and it does so with advantage if you or your companions are fighting it. If it fails the saving throw, it is {@condition Charmed} by you until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends or until you or your companions do anything harmful to it. The {@condition Charmed} creature is friendly to you. When the ability ends, the creature knows it was {@condition Charmed} by you.

{@b Invoke Awe (7 psi; conc., 10 min.)} As an action, you exert an aura that inspires awe in others. Choose up to 5 creatures you can see within 60 feet of you. Each target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition Charmed|phb} by you until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends. If you or creatures that are friendly to you are fighting it, it has advantage on the saving throw. While {@condition Charmed|phb}, the target obeys all your verbal commands to the best of its ability and without doing anything obviously self-destructive. The {@condition Charmed|phb} target will attack only creatures that it has seen attack you since it was {@condition Charmed|phb} or that it was already hostile toward. At the end of each of its turns, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

optionalfeature.name: Mantle of Command
entries: {@i Avatar Discipline}
You exert an aura of trust and authority, enhancing the coordination among your allies.

items: {@b Psychic Focus.} While focused on this discipline, you and allies within 10 feet of you who can see you have advantage on saving throws against being {@condition Frenzied|THICC} or effects that otherwise make them strike an ally.

{@b Coordinated Movement (1—7 psi)} As a bonus action, choose up to a number of allies per psi point spent you can see within 60 feet of you. Each of those allies can use their reaction to move up to half their speed, following a path of your choice.

{@b Combat Aura (2—7 psi; conc., 1 min.)} As an action, choose up to three allies you can see within 30 feet of you. You can target another two allies per additional psi point spent. Until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends, each target can roll a {@dice d4} when making an attack roll or saving throw and add the number rolled to the total.

{@b Commander's Orders (2 psi; conc., 1 min.)} As an action, choose one creature you can see within 60 feet of you. The target must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends, your allies have advantage on attack rolls against that target.

{@b Command to Strike (2 psi)} As a bonus action, choose one ally you can see within 60 feet of you. That ally can use their reaction to immediately make a single weapon attack. You choose the target.

{@b Strategic Mind (6 psi; conc., 1 min.)} As an action, you exert an aura of trust and command that unites your allies into a cohesive unit. Until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends, any ally within 30 feet of you on their turn can, as a bonus action, take the {@action Dash} or {@action Disengage} action or roll a {@dice d4} and add the number rolled to each attack roll they make that turn.

{@b Overwhelming Attack (7 psi)} As an action, choose up to five allies you can see within 60 feet of you. Each of those allies can use their reaction to make a single weapon attack. You choose the targets of the attacks.

optionalfeature.name: Mantle of Courage
entries: {@i Avatar Discipline}
You focus your mind on courage, radiating confidence and bravado to your allies.

items: {@b Psychic Focus.} While focused on this discipline, you and allies within 10 feet of you who can see you have advantage on saving throws against being {@condition Frightened}.

{@b Aura of Courage (1—7 psi; con., 10 min.)} As an action, you project psionic energy until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends. The energy fortifies you and your allies when they need it most. Every ally in the aura has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition Frightened}. Additionally, when an ally that you can see is reduced to 0 hit points by an enemy, you and each of your conscious allies within 30 feet of you gain a number of temporary hit points per psi point spent.

{@b Aura of Victory (1—7 psi; con., 10 min.)} As an action, you project psionic energy until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends. The energy fortifies you and your allies when your enemies are felled; whenever an enemy you can see is reduced to 0 hit points, you and each of your conscious allies within 30 feet of you gain temporary hit points equal to double the psi points spent to activate this effect.

{@b Encouraging Aura (2—7 psi; conc., 1 min.)} As an action, choose up to three allies you can see within 30 feet of you. You can target another two allies per additional psi point spent. Until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends, each target can roll a {@dice d4} when making an ability check or attack roll and add the number rolled to the total.
{@b Incite Courage (2 psi)} As an action, choose up to six creatures you can see within 60 feet of you. If any of those creatures is {@condition Frightened}, that condition ends on that creature.

{@b Pillar of Confidence (6 psi; conc., 1 rnd.)} As an action, you and up to five creatures you can see within 60 feet of you each gain one extra action to use on your individual turns. The action goes away if not used before the end of your next turn. The action can be used only to make one weapon attack or to take the {@action Dash} or {@action Disengage} action.

optionalfeature.name: Mantle of Fury
entries: {@i Avatar Discipline}
You allow the primal fury lurking deep within your mind to burst forth, catching you and your allies in an implacable bloodthirst.

items: {@b Psychic Focus.} While focused on this discipline, you and allies within 10 feet of you who can see you have advantage on saving throws against being {@condition Charmed}.

{@b Incite Fury (1—7 psi; con., 1 min.)} As an action, choose one ally you can see within 60 feet of you. Until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends, the target gains a bonus to melee weapon damage equal to the number of psi points spent.

{@b Furious Charge (2 psi)} As a bonus action, choose up to three creatures you can see within 60 feet of you. Each target can immediately use its reaction to move up to its speed in a straight line toward its nearest enemy.

{@b Thoughtless Fury (5 psi; conc., 1 min.)} As an action, you flood rage into one creature you can see within 60 feet of you. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw, or it can use its actions only to make melee attacks until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends. It can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

{@b Overwhelming Fury (6 psi; conc., 1 min.)} As an action, choose up to three allies you can see within 30 feet of you (you can choose yourself in place of one of the allies). Until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends, each target can roll a {@dice d4} when rolling damage for a melee weapon attack and add the number rolled to the damage roll.

{@b Aura of Bloodlust (7 psi; conc., 1 min.)} As an action, you unleash an aura of rage. Until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends, you and any creature within 30 feet of you has advantage on melee attack rolls.

optionalfeature.name: Mantle of Joy
entries: {@i Avatar Discipline}
You tap into the joy within you, radiating it outward in soothing, psychic energy that brings hope and comfort to creatures around you.

items: {@b Psychic Focus.} While focused on this discipline, you add {@dice 1d4} to the result of any Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) checks made by you.

{@b Soothe Pain (1—7 psi)} As an action, choose a creature you can see within 60 feet of you. The target gains a number of temporary hit points equal to {@dice 1d4} per psi point spent plus your Intelligence modifier.

{@b Soothing Presence (2—7 psi)} As an action, choose a number of creatures per psi point spent that you can see within 60 feet of you. Each target gains a number of temporary hit points equal to {@dice 1d4} plus your Intelligence modifier.

{@b Comforting Aura (2—7 psi; conc., 1 min.)} As an action, choose up to three allies you can see within 30 feet of you. You can target another two allies per additional psi point spent. Until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends, each target can roll a {@dice d4} when making an ability check or saving throw and add the number rolled to the total.

{@b Aura of Jubilation (3 psi; conc., 1 min.)} As an action, you radiate a distracting mirth until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends. Each creature within 60 feet of you that can see you suffers disadvantage on any checks using the {@skill Perception} and {@skill Investigation} skills.

{@b Calming Aura (3 psi; conc., 1 min.)} As an action, you radiate a gentle, soothing energy until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends. Every humanoid within 30 feet of you must make a Wisdom saving throw, which they can choose to fail. Any target under this feature’s influence that leaves the aura is no longer affected by this feature, but will be again if it enters the aura once more. When a humanoid who has not made the saving throw enters the aura for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, the humanoid must make the saving throw. For each target that fails the saving throw, any madness currently affecting the creature is suppressed for the duration of the effect, and you can choose one of the following two additional effects for that target: You can suppress any effect causing a target to be {@condition Charmed} or {@condition Frightened}. When this effect ends, any suppressed effect resumes, provided that its duration has not expired in the meantime. Alternatively, you can make a target indifferent about creatures of your choice that it is hostile toward. This indifference ends if the target is attacked or harmed by a spell or if it witnesses any of its friends being harmed. When the effect ends for that target, the creature becomes hostile again, unless the DM rules otherwise.

{@b Cure Madness (3—7 psi)} As an action, you touch a creature and reach into their mind, rooting out all impurities from within. The creature must make a Wisdom saving throw, which they can choose to fail. On a success, the creature is immune to the effects of this feature for 24 hours. On a failure, you remove one Short Term Madness currently affecting the creature. You can instead spend 2 additional psi points to remove one Long Term Madness currently affecting the creature, or 4 additional psi points to remove one Indefinite Madness currently affecting the creature.

{@b Beacon of Recovery (5 psi)} As a bonus action, you and up to five allies you can see within 60 feet of you can immediately make saving throws against every effect they’re suffering that allows a save at the start or end of their turns.

optionalfeature.name: Nomadic Arrow
entries: {@i Nomadic Discipline}
You imbue a ranged weapon with a strange semblance of sentience, allowing it to unerringly find its mark.

items: {@b Psychic Focus.} While you are focused on this discipline, you can use a bonus action to ignore the penalties for attacking at long range with a ranged weapon attack until the end of your turn.

{@b Speed Projectile (1—7 psi)} As an action, you make a ranged weapon attack using a ranged weapon you are wielding, imbuing one projectile you shoot with psionic power. This ranged weapon attack has its normal range increased by 10 feet per psi point spent and its maximum range increased by 3 times as much, using your discipline attack modifier for the attack and damage rolls. On a hit, the weapon deals its normal damage, plus an extra {@dice 1d8} force damage per psi point spent on this ability.

{@b Seeking Missile (2 psi)} As a reaction when you miss with a ranged weapon attack, you can repeat the attack roll against the same target, using your discipline attack modifier for the attack and damage rolls.

{@b Curved Missile (3 psi)} As a reaction when you miss with a ranged weapon attack, you can repeat the attack roll against a different target that you know of within 30 feet of the original target, using your discipline attack modifier for the attack and damage rolls. This extra range does not count towards determining your distance from the creature. You treat the attack as originating from the original target’s space for the purposes of determining {@quickref cover||3}, allowing you to potentially shoot around corners. However, for the purposes of determining disadvantage from a hostile creature within 5 feet, the shot still originates from your space. If you cannot see the creature, you still make this attack at disadvantage.

{@b Nomadic Projectile (5—7 psi)} As an action, you make a ranged weapon attack using a thrown or ranged weapon you are holding, teleporting the missile mid-flight. This ranged weapon attack uses your discipline attack modifier for the attack and damage rolls. You treat the attack as originating from any space within 30 feet of you for the purposes of determining distance and {@quickref cover||3}, allowing you to potentially shoot around corners. However, for the purposes of determining disadvantage from a hostile creature within 5 feet, the shot still originates from your space. If you cannot see the creature, you still make this attack at disadvantage. You can increase the distance you can teleport the projectile by 15 feet per additional psi point spent on it. The weapon or ammunition teleports to your grasp or ammunition container respectively after it attacks.

{@b Faithful Archer (7 psi; conc., 1 min.)} As a bonus action, you imbue a ranged weapon with a limited sentience. Until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends, you can make an extra attack with the weapon when you choose to take the Attack action with that weapon, using your discipline attack modifier for the attack and damage rolls for that extra attack. If it is a thrown ranged weapon, it returns to your grasp each time you make any attack with it.

optionalfeature.name: Nomadic Chameleon
entries: {@i Nomadic Discipline}
You create a screen of psychic power that distorts your appearance, allowing you to blend into the background or even turn invisible.

items: {@b Psychic Focus.} While focused on this discipline, you add {@dice 1d4} to the result of any Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made by you.

{@b Chameleon (1—7 psi)} As a part of a {@action Hide} action, you can give yourself a bonus to your Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check equal to the psi points spent as you change the color of your skin to create patterns that match your surroundings. This bonus lasts until you move or until an hour passes. You can use an action at any time to return the natural color of your skin.

{@b Impair Attention (1—7 psi)} As a reaction to when a creature within 60 feet of you makes a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check, you may force them to make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failure, you reduce the outcome of their Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check equal to the psi points spent.

{@b Mind Fog (2—7 psi; conc., 1 hr.)} As an action, you make yourself difficult for creatures to become consciously aware of. You can target one additional creature for every additional psi point you spend on this ability. The added targets must be visible to you and within 5 feet of you. Any creature that would normally see a target at a distance of 15 feet away or more must instead also succeed a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check against your Discipline Save DC, or else they do not notice the target. Any time the target moves within their line of sight and they would normally see the target, they may remake this save. If the target is within 15 feet of a creature that would normally see them, the creature automatically succeeds this check. If they succeed the check, the target is spotted by the creature and the creature is immune to the effects of this ability for the next hour. The ability ends for a target that attacks via magical or nonmagical means.

{@b Step from Sight (3—7 psi; conc., 1 hr.)} As an action, you cloak yourself from sight. You can target one additional creature for every additional 2 psi points you spend on this ability. The added targets must be visible to you and within 5 feet of you. Each target turns {@condition Invisible} and remains so until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends or until immediately after it attacks, casts a spell, or uses a psionic talent or discipline. Activating a psychic focus effect does not end the invisibility.
{@b Remain Unseen (7 psi; conc., 1 min.)} As an action, you turn {@action Invisible} and remain so until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends.

optionalfeature.name: Nomadic Mind
entries: {@i Nomadic Discipline}
You dispatch part of your psyche into the noosphere, the collective vista of minds and knowledge possessed by living things.

items: {@b Psychic Focus.} While focused on this discipline, you add {@dice 1d4} to the result of any Intelligence ({@skill History}) checks made by you.

{@b Item Lore (1—7 psi; conc., 1 hr.)} You enter a deep contemplation, probing the noosphere for its knowledge. Choose a number of objects within 5 feet of you up to five times the number of psi points spent. Uncommon items count as 2 objects, rare items count as 3 objects, very rare items count as 4 objects, legendary items count as 5 objects, and artifacts count as 10 objects. If you concentrate for this option’s full duration while those items are within 5 feet of you, you learn a plethora of information about them. If the target of your focus is a magic item, you learn its properties and how to use them, whether it requires attunement to use, and how many charges it has, if any. If the item was created by a spell, you learn that it was and about the spell that created it. If the item is blessed or cursed, you learn the properties and triggers of the blessing or curse on the item. Someone on your plane of existence must know the knowledge you seek to gain from this feature. You learn whether or not you have an answer to the above pieces of information for a given item. If you chose too many items due to unknown rarity, you instead learn about them in the order that you chose them until your object count is reached. If you are unable to meet the threshold for a certain item’s rarity while you have one or more objects remaining, you learn the rarity of the item that you were in the process of identifying when your concentration ends. For example, if you spent 1 psi point on this ability and chose to identify an uncommon item, a common item, a rare item, an artifact, and another common item, you learn about the uncommon item and the first common item, and that the rare item is a rare item, while not learning anything of the other two items.

{@b Seek Object (3 psi; conc., 1 hr.)} You cast your mind to the noosphere for information about a specific object. If you concentrate for this option’s full duration, you learn an object’s last known location as long as someone on your plane of existence has seen or interacted with the object and recognized it as such. You learn the plane of existence, region, city, town, village, or district (DM’s choice) where it is or was last seen, along with a general sense of how recent the information you gather is.

{@b Wandering Mind (3—7 psi; conc., 1 hr.)} You enter a deep contemplation, probing the noosphere for its experience. If you concentrate for this option’s full duration, you then gain proficiency with a skill, tool, or language of your choice as long as at least one person on your plane of existence has proficiency in your choice. You can gain proficiency in an additional skill or tool per additional psi point spent on it. The benefit lasts for 1 hour, no {@status concentration||concentration} required.

{@b Psychic Speech (5 psi)} As an action, you attune your mind to the psychic imprint of all language. For 1 hour, you gain the ability to understand any language you hear or attempt to read. In addition, when you speak, all creatures that can understand a language understand what you say, regardless of what language you use.

{@b Find Creature (6 psi; conc., 1 hr.)} You cast your mind about for information about a specific creature. If you concentrate for this option’s full duration, you then gain a general understanding of the creature’s current location. You learn the region, city, town, village, or district where it is (DM’s choice). If the creature is on another plane of existence, you instead learn which plane.

{@b Masterful Mind (7 psi; conc., 1 hr.)} You enter a deep contemplation, drawing on the combined knowledge of the noosphere. If you concentrate for this option’s full duration, you then gain expertise with a skill or tool of your choice or proficiency in a weapon or armor of your choice as long as at least one person on your plane of existence has the respective expertise or proficiency in your choice.The benefit lasts for 8 hours or until you use this ability again, no {@status concentration||concentration} required.

optionalfeature.name: Nomadic Step
entries: {@i Nomadic Discipline}
You exert your mind on the area around you, twisting the intraplanar pathways you perceive to allow instantaneous travel.

items: {@b Psychic Focus.} While focused on this discipline, when you take the {@action Dash} action, {@quickref difficult terrain||3} doesn't cost you extra movement on that turn.
{@b Step of a Dozen Paces (1—7 psi)} You use a bonus action to teleport up to 10 feet per psi point spent to an unoccupied space you can see.

{@b Nomadic Anchor (1 psi)} As an action, you create an {@condition Invisible}, intangible teleportation anchor in a 5-foot cube you can see within 120 feet of you. For the next 8 hours, or until you create another anchor, whenever you use this psionic discipline to teleport, you can instead teleport to the anchor, even if you can’t see it, but it must be within range of the teleportation ability.

{@b There and Back Again (2 psi)} As a bonus action, you teleport up to 15 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. At the end of your turn, you can choose to teleport back to the spot you occupied before teleporting, unless it is now occupied or on a different plane of existence.

{@b Transposition (3 psi)} Choose a willing creature you can see within 60 feet of you. As a bonus action, you and that creature teleport, swapping places. This ability fails and is wasted if either of you can’t fit in the destination space.

{@b Baleful Transposition (5 psi)} As an action, choose one creature you can see within 120 feet of you. That creature must make a Charisma saving throw, which they can choose to fail. On a failed save, you and that creature teleport, swapping places. This ability fails and is wasted if either of you can’t fit in the destination space.

{@b Defensive Step (6 psi)} As a reaction when you are hit by an attack, you teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within 10 feet of you, causing the attack to miss if it does not also target that space.

{@b Psychoportation (6 psi)} As an action, you teleport yourself from your current location to any other spot within 500 feet. You arrive at exactly the spot desired. It can be a place you can see, one you can visualize, or one you can describe by stating distance and direction, such as "200 feet straight downward" or "upward to the northwest at a 45-degree angle, 300 feet." You can bring along objects as long as their weight doesn't exceed what you can carry. You can also bring one willing creature of your size or smaller who is carrying gear up to its carrying capacity. The creature must be within 5 feet of you when you create this effect. If you would arrive in a place already occupied by an object or a creature, you and any creature traveling with you each take {@dice 4d6} force damage, and the ability fails to teleport you.

{@b Nomad's Gate (7 psi; conc., 1 hr.)} As an action, you create a 5-foot cube of dim, gray light within 5 feet of you. You create an identical cube at any point of your choice within 1 mile that you have viewed within the past 24 hours. Until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends, anyone entering one of the cubes immediately teleports to the other one, appearing in an unoccupied space next to it. The teleportation fails if there is no space for the creature to appear in.

optionalfeature.name: Photokinesis
entries: {@i Wu Jen Discipline}
You claim dominion over light and darkness with your mind.

items: {@b Psychic Focus.} While focused on this discipline, areas in dim light do not count as lightly obscured areas for you.

{@b Darkness (1—7 psi)} As an action, you create an area of magical darkness, which foils darkvision. Choose a spot you can see within 60 feet of you. Magical darkness radiates from that point in a sphere with a 5-foot radius per psi point spent on this ability. The light produced by spells of 2nd level or less is suppressed in this area.

{@b Emit Light (1—7 psi)} As an action, an object you touch spent no larger than 10 feet in any dimension radiates light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet for 1 hour per psi point spent. The light can be colored as you like. Completely covering the object with something opaque blocks the light. If you target an object held or worn by a hostile creature, that creature must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw to avoid your touch.

{@b Revealing Glow (2 psi; conc., 1 min.)} As an action, each object in a 10-foot radius within 60 feet of you faintly glows. Any creature in the area must succeed a Charisma saving throw or also faintly glow. Any creature or object glowing sheds dim light in a 10-foot radius. The light lasts until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends. Creatures glowing in this way can’t benefit from being {@condition Invisible}, as creatures can see it by its glow, and any attack roll against any creature or object glowing in this way has advantage if the attacker can see it.

{@b Animate Shadows (3—7 psi; conc., 1 hr.)} As an action, you cause one to three shadows (one additional shadow for every 2 additional psi points spent) to appear in an unoccupied space you can see within 60 feet of you. The space must be an area of complete darkness created by you, or a space behind a creature or object casting a shadow from a light you create. The shadows last until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends, and they obey your verbal commands. In combat, roll for their initiatives, and choose their behavior during their turns. When this effect ends, the shadows disappear. The DM has their stat block.

{@b Radiant Beam (5—7 psi; conc., 1 min.)} As an action, you project a beam of light at one creature you can see within 60 feet of you. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, it takes {@dice 6d10} radiant damage and is {@condition Blinded} until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends. A {@condition Blinded} target can make a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. You can increase this effect’s damage by {@dice 1d10} per each additional psi point spent on it.

{@b Sunlight (5 psi)} A 30-foot-radius sphere of light spreads for one minute from a point you choose or an object that is not being worn or carried by anyone other than you. The sphere is bright light and sheds dim light for an additional 30 feet. This light is sunlight. If you chose an object, the light shines from and moves with the object. Completely covering the object with something opaque blocks the light. If any of this effects’ area overlaps with darkness made by a spell of 3rd level or lower, or by the Darkness feature of this discipline, the darkness is suppressed in this area.

{@b Animate Greater Shadow (7 psi; conc., 1 hr.)} As an action, you cause a greater shadow to appear in an unoccupied space you can see within 60 feet of you. The space must be an area of complete darkness, or a space behind a creature or object casting a shadow. The shadow lasts until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends, and they obey your verbal commands. In combat, roll for their initiative, and choose their behavior during their turns. When this effect ends, the greater shadow disappears. The DM has their stat block.

optionalfeature.name: Precognition
entries: {@i Awakened Discipline}
By analyzing information around you, from subtle hints to seemingly disconnected facts, you learn to weave a string of probabilities in an instant that gives you extraordinary insights.

items: {@b Psychic Focus.} While focused on this discipline, you have a bonus to your initiative rolls equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of +1).

{@b Precognitive Hunch (2 psi; conc., 1 hr.)} As an action, you open yourself to receive momentary insights that improve your odds of success; until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends, whenever you make an attack roll, a saving throw, or an ability check, you roll a {@dice d4} and add it to the total.
{@b All-Around Sight (3 psi)} In response to an attack hitting you, you use your reaction to impose disadvantage on the attack, possibly causing it to miss.

{@b Danger Sense (7 psi; conc., 8 hr.)} As an action, you create a psychic model of reality in your mind and set it to show you a few seconds into the future. Until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends, you can’t be surprised, attack rolls against you can’t gain advantage, and you gain a +10 bonus to initiative.

optionalfeature.name: Psionic Restoration
entries: {@i Immortal Discipline}
You wield psionic energy to cure wounds and restore health to yourself and others.

items: {@b Psychic Focus.} While focused on this discipline, you can use an action to touch a creature that has 0 hit points and stabilize it.

{@b Mend Wounds (1—7 psi)} As an action, you can spend psi points to restore hit points to one non-undead non-construct creature you touch. The creature regains hit points equal to {@dice 1d4} per psi point spent plus your Intelligence modifier.

{@b Restore Health (3 psi)} As an action, you touch one non-undead non-construct creature and remove one of the following conditions from it: {@condition Blinded}, {@condition Deafened}, {@condition Paralyzed}, or {@condition Poisoned}. Alternatively, you remove one disease from the creature.

{@b Mass Mend Wounds (5—7 psi)} As an action, you can spend psi points to send a surge of healing around you. A number of non-undead non-construct creatures per psi point spent within 60 feet of you regain hit points equal to {@dice 1d10} + your Intelligence modifier.

{@b Defy Death (6 psi)} As an action, you touch one non-undead non-construct creature and grant it a measure of protection from death for 8 hours. The first time the target would drop to 0 hit points as a result of taking damage, the target instead drops to 1 hit point, and the ability ends on that target. If the ability is still in effect when the target is subjected to an effect that would kill it instantaneously without dealing damage, that effect is instead negated against the target, and the ability ends on that target.

{@b Hasten Vitality (7 psi)} As an action, you touch one non-undead non-construct creature and temporarily hasten its natural healing ability. For 10 minutes, the target regains {@dice 1d2-1} hit points at the start of each of its turns ({@dice 10d2-10} hit points each minute). In addition, once per turn for the duration of the effect, the target can choose to perform a healing surge, rolling a hit die to recover hit points.

optionalfeature.name: Psionic Weapon
entries: {@i Soulknife Discipline}
You have learned how to channel psionic energy into your attacks, lending them devastating power.

items: {@b Psychic Focus.} Whenever you focus on this discipline, you are able to draw, stow, or swap one object in or to your hand(s) without using a bonus action up to twice per round.

{@b Psychic Strike (1—7 psi)} As a bonus action when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you imbue the attack with psychic energy, dealing an extra {@dice 1d8} psychic damage per psi point spent.

{@b Ethereal Weapon (2 psi)} When you take the {@action Attack} action, you can use a bonus action to temporarily transform one weapon you’re holding or your unarmed strike into pure psionic energy. For the rest of your turn, the weapon ignores the target’s armor, requiring no attack roll. Instead, the target makes a Dexterity saving throw against this discipline. On a failed save, the target takes the attack’s normal damage and suffers any of its additional effects. On a successful save, the target takes half damage from the attack but suffers no additional effects that would normally be imposed on a hit.

{@b Augmented Weapon (3—7 psi; conc., 1 hr.)} As a bonus action, touch one simple or martial weapon. Until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends, that weapon becomes a magic weapon with a +1 bonus to its attack and damage rolls. This bonus increases by +1 for every 2 additional psi points spent.

{@b Staggering Strike (6—7 psi)} As a bonus action when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, your weapon disrupts their thoughts, dealing an extra {@dice 4d6} psychic damage. The target must then make a Wisdom saving throw. On failed save, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks, and can’t take reactions until the end of its next turn. You can increase the damage by {@dice 1d6} per additional psi point spent on it.

optionalfeature.name: Psychic Assault
entries: {@i Awakened Discipline}
You wield your mind like a weapon, unleashing salvos of psionic energy.

items: {@b Psychic Focus.} While focused on this discipline, when you cast a psionic talent that deals damage of any type, you can spend any number of psi points up to your psi limit to increase its damage by {@dice 1d2} per psi point spent.
{@b Psionic Blast (1—7 psi)} As an action, choose one creature you can see within 60 feet of you. The target takes {@dice 1d6} psychic damage per psi point spent on this ability.

{@b Ego Whip (3—7 psi)} As an action, choose one creature you can see within 60 feet of you. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. A creature automatically succeeds if it is immune to being {@condition Frightened}. On a failed save, the creature takes {@dice 3d8} psychic damage, and it is filled with self-doubt, leaving it able to use its action on its next turn only to take the {@action Dodge}, {@action Disengage}, or {@action Hide} action. On a successful saving throw, it takes half as much damage. You can increase the damage by {@dice 1d6} per additional psi point spent on it.

{@b Id Insinuation (5 psi)} As an action, choose one creature you can see within 60 feet of you. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. A target makes the saving throw at disadvantage if the creature has disadvantage on saving throws against being {@condition Frenzied|THICC}. A creature automatically succeeds if it is immune to being {@condition Frenzied|THICC}. On a failed save, the creature takes {@dice 5d8} psychic damage, and it goes into a fury, as its id runs rampant. On its next turn, it can use its action only to take the {@action Dodge} or {@action Attack} action. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage.

{@b Psychic Blast (6 psi)} As an action, you unleash devastating psychic energy in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make an Intelligence saving throw, taking {@dice 8d8} psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. You can increase the damage by {@dice 2d8} if you spend 1 more psi point on this ability.

{@b Psychic Crush (7 psi)} As an action, you create a 20-foot cube of psychic energy within 120 feet of you. Each creature in that area must make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes {@dice 8d8} psychic damage and is {@condition Stunned} until the end of your next turn. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage.

optionalfeature.name: Psychic Disruption
entries: {@i Awakened Discipline}
You create psychic static that disrupts other creatures’ ability to think clearly.

items: {@b Psychic Focus.} While focused on this discipline, you can use a bonus action to attempt to weaken an opponent’s mental defenses. Target one creature within 30 feet of you that you can see. The creature must make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failure, the creature subtracts {@dice 1d4} from the next Intelligence saving throw that it makes until the end of your next turn. On a success, the creature is immune to the effects of this focus for 24 hours.

{@b Distracting Haze (1—7 psi; conc., 1 min.)} As an action, choose one creature you can see within 60 feet of you. That creature must make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@dice 1d10} psychic damage per psi point spent and can’t see anything more than 10 feet from it until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage.

{@b Daze (2 psi; conc., 1 min.)} As an action, choose one creature you can see within 60 feet of you. That creature must make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, the target is {@condition Incapacitated} until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends. At the end of each of the target’s turns, and each time it takes damage, the target can make another Intelligence saving throw. The target has advantage on the saving throw if it’s triggered by damage. On a success, the effect ends.

{@b Mental Shackles (3—7 psi)} As an action, choose one creature you can see within 90 feet of you. That creature must make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes {@dice 3d6} psychic damage, and it can’t take a reaction until the end of its next turn. Moreover, on its next turn, it must choose whether it gets a move, an action, or a bonus action; it only gets one of the three. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and does not suffer any other adverse effects. You can increase the damage by {@dice 1d6} per additional psi point spent on this ability.

{@b Stun (3 psi)} As an action, choose one creature you can see within 60 feet of you. That creature must make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, the target is {@condition Stunned} until the end of your next turn. If the creature is damaged, it can remake the saving throw at advantage, ending the stun on a success.

{@b Mind Storm (5—7 psi)} As an action, choose a point you can see within 60 feet of you. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes {@dice 6d8} psychic damage and suffers disadvantage on its next saving throw until the end of your next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage. You can increase the damage by {@dice 1d6} per additional psi point spent on this ability.

optionalfeature.name: Psychic Inquisition
entries: {@i Awakened Discipline}
You reach into a creature’s mind to uncover information or plant ideas within it.

items: {@b Psychic Focus.} While focused on this discipline, you have advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) checks to determine whether or not a creature is being truthful while speaking telepathically with that creature.

{@b Hammer of Inquisition (1—7 psi; conc., 1 min.)} As an action, choose one creature you can see within 60 feet of you. The target must make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@dice 1d10} psychic damage per psi point spent and suffers disadvantage on its next Wisdom saving throw before the end of your next turn. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and does not suffer disadvantage on its next Wisdom saving throw.

{@b Forceful Query (2 psi)} As an action, you ask a question of one creature that can see and hear you within 30 feet of you. The question must be phrased so that it can be answered with a yes or no, otherwise this ability fails. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw, or it replies with a truthful answer. You know whether or not the target succeeded their saving throw. A creature is immune to this ability if it is immune to being {@condition Charmed}.

{@b Read Thoughts (3 psi; conc., 1 min.)} For the duration, you can read and detect the thoughts of certain creatures, as described below. When manifest this ability, both options below trigger, and as an action on each turn until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends, you can manifest one of the following options as an action:

{@b Read Thoughts.} You focus your mind on any one creature that you can see within 30 feet of you. If the creature you choose has an Intelligence of 3 or lower or doesn't speak any language, the creature is unaffected. You initially learn the surface thoughts of the creature—what is most on its mind in that moment. If you take this option again, you can either shift your attention to another creature's thoughts or attempt to probe deeper into the same creature's mind. If you probe deeper, the target must make a Wisdom saving throw. If it fails, you gain insight into its reasoning (if any), its emotional state, and something that looms large in its mind (such as something it worries over, loves, or hates). If it succeeds, the target breaks your {@status concentration||concentration}. Either way, the target knows that you are probing into its mind, and unless you shift your attention to another creature's thoughts, the creature can use its action on its turn to remake the Wisdom saving throw, breaking your {@status concentration||concentration} on a success. Questions verbally directed at the target creature naturally shape the course of its thoughts, so this ability is particularly effective as part of an interrogation.

{@b Detect Thoughts} You search for thoughts within 30 feet of you, detecting the presence of thinking creatures you can't see. The ability can penetrate barriers, but 2 feet of rock, 2 inches of any metal other than lead, or a thin sheet of lead blocks you. You can't detect a creature with an Intelligence of 3 or lower or one that doesn't speak any language. Once you detect the presence of a creature in this way, you can use the Read Thoughts option on it, even if you can't see it, but it must still be within range.

{@b Ransack Mind (5 psi; conc., 1 hr.)} While you concentrate on this ability, you probe one creature's mind. The creature must remain within 30 feet of you, and you must be able to see it. If you concentrate for the ability’s full duration, the target must make three Wisdom saving throws, and you learn information from it based on the number of saving throws it fails. With one failed saving throw, you learn its key memories from the past 12 hours. With two failed saving throws, you learn its key memories from the past 24 hours. With three failed saving throws, you learn its key memories from the past 48 hours.

{@b Phantom Idea (6 psi; conc., 1 hr.)} While you concentrate on this ability, you probe one creature's mind. The creature must remain within 30 feet of you, and you must be able to see it. If you reach the ability’s full duration, the target must make three Wisdom saving throws, and you plant a memory or an idea in it, which lasts for a number of hours based on the number of saving throws it fails. You choose whether the idea or memory is trivial (such as "I had porridge for breakfast" or "Ale is the worst") or personality-defining ("I failed to save my village from orc marauders and am therefore a coward" or "Magic is a scourge, so I renounce it"). A directly harmful, or contradictory, idea or memory (Such as "I love getting hit with clubs" or fond memories of getting eaten by a dragon and dying) are dismissed by the target.
