With one failed saving throw, the idea or memory lasts for the next 4 hours. With two failed saving throws, it lasts for 24 hours. With three failed saving throws, it lasts for 48 hours.

{@b Modify Memory (7 psi; conc., 1 min.)} As an action, you attempt to reshape another creature's memories within 30 feet of you. One creature that you can see must make a Wisdom saving throw. If you are fighting the creature, it has advantage on the saving throw. On a failed save, the target becomes {@condition Charmed} by you for the duration. The {@condition Charmed} target is {@condition Incapacitated} and unaware of its surroundings, though it can still hear you. If it takes any damage or is targeted by a spell, psionic discipline, or psionic talent, this effect ends, and none of the target's memories are modified. While this charm lasts, you can affect the target's memory of an event that it experienced within the last 24 hours and that lasted no more than 10 minutes. You can permanently eliminate all memory of the event, allow the target to recall the event with perfect clarity and exacting detail, change its memory of the details of the event, or create a memory of some other event. You must speak to the target to describe how its memories are affected, and it must be able to understand your language for the modified memories to take root. Its mind fills in any gaps in the details of your description. If the effect ends before you have finished describing the modified memories, the creature's memory isn't altered. Otherwise, the modified memories take hold at the end of the minute you spend in {@status concentration||concentration}. A modified memory doesn't necessarily affect how a creature behaves, particularly if the memory contradicts the creature's natural inclinations, alignment, or beliefs. An illogical modified memory, such as implanting a memory of how much the creature enjoyed dousing itself in acid, is dismissed, perhaps as a bad dream. The DM might deem a modified memory too nonsensical to affect a creature in a significant manner. A dispel psionics feature or {@spell Greater Restoration|PHB} spell cast on the target restores the creature's true memory.

optionalfeature.name: Psychic Phantoms
entries: {@i Awakened Discipline}
Your power reaches into a creature’s mind and causes it false perceptions.

items: {@b Psychic Focus.} While focused on this discipline, you add {@dice 1d4} to the result of any Charisma ({@skill Deception}) checks made by you.

{@b Distracting Figment (1—7 psi)} As an action, choose one creature you can see within 60 feet of you. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@dice 1d10} psychic damage per psi point spent and thinks it perceives a threatening creature just out of its sight; until the end of your next turn, it can’t use reactions. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage.

{@b Phantom Foe (3—7 psi; conc., 1 min.)} As an action, choose one creature you can see within 60 feet of you. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it perceives a horrid creature adjacent to it until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends. A creature automatically succeeds if it is immune to being {@condition Frightened}. During this time, the target can’t take reactions, and it takes {@dice 1d8} psychic damage at the start of each of its turns. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. You can increase the damage by {@dice 1d8} for each additional psi point spent on the ability.

{@b Phantom Betrayal (5 psi; conc., 1 min.)} As an action, you plant delusional paranoia in a creature’s mind. Choose one creature you can see within 60 feet of you. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw, or until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends, it becomes {@condition Frenzied|THICC}. A target makes the saving throw at disadvantage if the creature has disadvantage on saving throws against being {@condition Frenzied|THICC}. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

{@b Phantom Riches (7 psi; conc., 1 min.)} As an action, you plant the phantom of a greatly desired object in a creature’s mind. Choose one creature you can see within 60 feet of you. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, you gain partial control over the target’s behavior until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends; the target moves as you wish on each of its turns, as it thinks it pursues the object of its deepest desires, just out of reach. If it hasn’t taken damage since its last turn, it can use its action only to admire the object you created in its perception. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

optionalfeature.name: Pyrokinesis
entries: {@i Wu Jen Discipline}
You align your mind with the energy of elemental fire.

items: {@b Psychic Focus.} While focused on this discipline, any fire damage you take is reduced by 3.

{@b Burning Ball (1—7 psi)} As an action, you project a big ball of fire in a 20-foot by 5-foot line in front of you. Any creature in the line must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@dice 1d10} fire damage per psi point spent, or half as much on a successful save. The fire ignites any flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried.

{@b Fire Burst (1—7 psi)} As an action, you project a burst of flames in a 15-foot cone in front of you. Any creature in the cone must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@dice 1d8} fire damage per psi point spent, or half as much on a successful save. The fire ignites any flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried.

{@b Spontaneous Combustion (1—7 psi; conc., 1 min.)} As an action, choose one creature or object you can see within 90 feet of you that isn't {@condition Submerged|THICC} in water. The target must make a Charisma saving throw. The target takes {@dice 1d6} fire damage per psi point spent on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. On a failed save, the target also catches on fire until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends or until it or a creature adjacent to it extinguishes the flames as an action by making a successful Dexterity saving throw or using enough water to douse the target. While aflame, the burning target sheds bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet. Additionally, the flaming target takes {@dice 1d4} fire damage per psi point spent at the end of each of its turns.

{@b Rolling Flame (3—7 psi; conc., 1 min.)} As an action, you create fire in a 20-foot-by-20-foot cube within 5 feet of you. The fire lasts until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends. Any creature that starts its turn in the area or moves into the area for the first time on a turn must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@dice 1d8} fire damage on a failed save or half as much on a success. You can increase the size of the cube by 5 feet in each dimension per additional psi point spent on it. You can increase the size of the cube by 5 feet in each dimension per additional psi point spent on it. The fire ignites any flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried.

{@b Detonation (5—7 psi)} As an action, you create a fiery explosion at a point you can see within 120 feet of you. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@dice 4d6} fire damage, {@dice 3d6} thunder damage, and being knocked prone on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. You can increase both the fire and thunder damage by {@dice 1d6} per additional psi point spent on it. The fire ignites any flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried.

{@b Fire Form (6 psi; conc., 10 min.)} As a bonus action, you become wreathed in flames until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends, shedding bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet. Any creature that moves within 5 feet of you for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@dice 3d6} fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

{@b Animate Fire (7 psi; conc., 1 hr.)} As an action, you cause a fire elemental to appear in an unoccupied space filled with fire that you can see within 120 feet of you. The elemental lasts until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends, and it obeys your verbal commands. In combat, roll for its initiative, and choose its behavior during its turns. When this effect ends, the elemental disappears. The DM has their stat block.

optionalfeature.name: Somnial Sway
entries: {@i Awakened Discipline}
Your power allows you to reach into creatures’ minds and affect their state of being awake or asleep.

items: {@b Psychic Focus.} While focused on this discipline, you are able to control when you sleep. Magic and psionics are unable to put you to sleep unless you are willing. Additionally, if you are a creature that can sleep, you can use an action to put yourself into a mundane sleep or nap.

{@b Power Nap (1—7 psi)} As an action, a willing creature of your choice that you can see within 30 feet of you falls {@condition Unconscious} for 1 hour. The feature ends on the target early if it takes damage or someone uses an action to shake or slap it awake. If the target remains {@condition Unconscious} for the full hour, that target gains the benefit of a short rest, and it regains a number hit points equal to {@dice 1d6} per psi point spent plus your Intelligence modifier, and it reduces its exhaustion level by one. Undead, constructs, and creatures immune to being {@condition Charmed} or that cannot sleep aren't affected by this feature.

{@b Sleep (1—7 psi)} As an action, choose a point you can see within 90 feet of you. Roll {@dice 2d10} per psi point spent and add your Intelligence modifier; the total is how many hit points of creatures this feature can affect. Creatures within 20 feet of the chosen point are affected in ascending order of their current hit points (ignoring {@condition Unconscious} creatures). Starting with the creature that has the lowest current hit points, each creature affected by this feature falls {@condition Unconscious} for 1 minute, the sleeper takes damage, or someone uses an action to shake or slap the sleeper awake. Subtract each creature's hit points from the total before moving on to the creature with the next lowest hit points. A creature's hit points must be equal to or less than the remaining total for that creature to be affected. Undead, constructs, and creatures immune to being {@condition Charmed} or that cannot sleep aren't affected by this feature.

{@b Sudden Awakening (2 psi)} As an action, you evoke a primal sense of danger within those around you. Each sleeping creature you choose within range awakens, every surprised creature you choose within range is no longer surprised, and each {@condition Prone} creature within range you choose can stand up without expending any movement.

{@b Catnap (5—7 psi)} As an action, up to three willing creatures of your choice that you can see within 30 feet of you fall {@condition Unconscious} for 10 minutes. You may increase the number of creatures you can affect with this feature by two per additional psi point spent. The feature ends on a target early if it takes damage or someone uses an action to shake or slap it awake. If a target remains {@condition Unconscious} for the full 10 minutes, that target gains the benefit of a short rest, and it can't be affected by this feature again until it finishes a long rest. If the creatures affected by this feature are affected by Power Nap, Undead, constructs, and creatures immune to being {@condition Charmed} or that cannot sleep aren't affected by this feature.

{@b Dream (7 psi)} Over the course of a minute, choose a creature within 90 feet of you that you know of. Creatures that don't sleep, such as elves, can't be contacted by this feature. You, or a willing creature you touch, enters a trance state for up to 8 hours, acting as a messenger. While in the trance, the messenger is aware of his or her surroundings, but can't take actions or move. If the target is asleep, the messenger appears in the target's dreams and can converse with the target as long as it remains asleep, through the duration of the feature. The messenger can also shape the environment of the dream, creating landscapes, objects, and other images. The messenger can emerge from the trance at any time, ending the effect of the feature early. The target recalls the dream perfectly upon waking. If the target is awake when you cast the feature, the messenger knows it, and can either end the trance (and the feature) or wait for the target to fall asleep, at which point the messenger appears in the target's dreams. You can make the messenger appear monstrous and terrifying to the target. If you do, the messenger can deliver a message of no more than ten words and then the target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, echoes of the phantasmal monstrosity spawn a nightmare that lasts the duration of the target's sleep and prevents the target from gaining any benefit from that rest. In addition, when the target wakes up, it takes {@dice 3d6} psychic damage. If you can see the target, the target makes its saving throw with disadvantage.

optionalfeature.name: Telekinetic Control
entries: {@i Wu Jen Discipline}

As a student of psionic power, you perceive the potential energy that flows through all things. You reach out with your mind, transforming the potential into the actual. Objects and creatures move at your command.

items: {@b Psychic Focus.} While focused on this discipline, any time you use a psionic talent, discipline, or feature to knock or shove a target away from you, you can instead pull the creature towards you, and vice versa. This cannot be used to force a target behind you.

{@b Push (1—7 psi)} As an action, choose one creature you can see within 60 feet of you. The target must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@dice 1d4} force damage per psi point spent and is pushed up to 5 feet per point spent in a straight line away from you. The length of the push is reduced by 5 feet for each size category larger the creature is than you. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and is not pushed away from you.

{@b Move (2—7 psi)} As an action, you awaken your telekinetic abilities. When you use this feature and at any point until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends, you choose one object you can see within 60 feet of you that isn’t being worn or carried by another creature and that isn’t secured in place and move it up to 30 feet. You can also exert fine control on objects with your telekinetic grip, such as manipulating a simple tool, opening a door or a container, stowing or retrieving an item from an open container, or pouring the contents from a vial. You can affect the same target round after round, or choose a new one at any time. If you switch targets, the prior target is no longer affected by this ability. The object's maximum weight depends on the psi points spent on this ability, as shown below. If the object is ever more than 60 feet from you or if lifting the object would exceed your maximum weight limit, the effect ends on that object. You can’t make an object travel fast enough or apply enough pressure to deal damage. If the object is in the air when this ability ends on it, it falls. If the object would fall on a creature, the creature must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw or split the damage as listed on the table below. On a successful save or if there is no creature, the object entirely takes the damage instead. The bludgeoning damage corresponds with the weight of the object being dropped, rather than the Psi points spent. For example, if a jar weighing 5 lbs was dropped using 7 psi points on this feature, it will still only deal {@dice 1d6} bludgeoning damage as it is within 25 lbs of weight.

{@b Grasp (3—7 psi; conc., 10 min.)} You attempt to grasp a Medium or smaller creature in telekinetic energy and hold it captive. You may spend 2 additional psi points to grab a Large creature, or 4 additional psi points to grab a Huge creature. As an action, choose one creature you can see within 60 feet of you. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be {@condition grappled|phb} by you until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends or until the target is more than 60 feet from you. The {@condition grappled|phb} target can escape by using an action to {@skill Athletics} check contested by your discipline save DC, freeing itself on a success. While a target is {@condition grappled|phb} in this manner, you create one of the following effects as an action:
{@b Move (1 psi)} You move the target up to 30 feet. You can move it in the air and hold it there. It falls if the grapple ends.
{@b Crush (1—7 psi)} The target must succeed a Strength saving throw or take {@dice 1d10} bludgeoning damage per psi point spent, with half as much on a success.
{@b Restrain (2 psi)} You deepen the grasp you hold on the target, causing them to be {@condition restrained|phb} while they are grappled in this way.

{@b Telekinetic Blast (5—7 psi)} As an action, you unleash a destructive wave of mental power in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes {@dice 4d8} force damage, is pushed 20 feet directly away from you, and is knocked {@condition Prone|phb}. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage and is not pushed or knocked {@condition Prone|phb}. You can increase the damage by {@dice 1d8} per additional psi point spent.

optionalfeature.name: Telekinetic Protection
entries: {@i Wu Jen Discipline}

As a student of psionic power, you perceive the potential energy that flows through all things. You reach out with your mind, transforming the potential into the actual. You create invisible barriers out of thin air for protection.

items: {@b Psychic Focus.} While focused on this discipline, any force damage you take is reduced by 3.

{@b Inertial Armor (2 psi)} As an action, you sheathe yourself in an intangible field of psionic force. For 8 hours, your base AC becomes 13 + your Dexterity modifier. This effect ends if you are wearing or don armor.

{@b Shatter the Sky (3—7 psi; conc., 10 min.)} As an action, you crack the air in a 5-foot radius sphere within 60 feet of yourself, leaving it rife with transparent and reflective shards of telekinetic energy until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends. A creature that enters the shattered area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there takes {@dice 3d4} force damage. You can increase the damage done by {@dice 1d4} per additional psi point spent.

{@b Telekinetic Barrier (3—7 psi; conc., 10 min.)} As an action, you create a transparent wall of telekinetic energy, at least one portion of which must be within 60 feet of you. The wall is 40 feet long, 10 feet high, and 1 inch thick. The wall lasts until your concentration ends. Each 10-foot section of the wall has an AC of 13 and 10 hit points per psi point spent on this feature. When struck, the field shimmers energetically at the point struck. When a section is broken, it looks as if the air itself cracks and shatters at the point of impact, leaving floating shards of telekinetic energy. Until your concentration ends, any creature that moves through the broken section of wall for the first time on a turn must suffer {@dice 1d4} force damage.
{@b Telekinetic Resistance (5 psi)} As an action, you gain resistance to force damage for 1 hour.

{@b Telekinetic Wall (7 psi; conc., 10 min.)} As an action, you create an impenetrable transparent wall of telekinetic energy, which lasts until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends. The wall appears in any orientation you choose, as a horizontal or vertical barrier or at an angle. It can be free floating or resting on a solid surface. You can form it into a hemispherical dome or a sphere with a radius of up to 10 feet, or you can shape a flat surface made up of ten 10-foot-by-10-foot panels. Each panel must be contiguous with another panel. In any form, the wall is 1 inch thick. It lasts for the duration. If the wall cuts through a creature's space when it appears, the creature is pushed to one side of the wall (your choice which side). Nothing can physically pass through the wall. It is immune to all damage, and can be dispelled by the Psion’s Dispel Psionics feature. A disintegrate spell also destroys the wall instantly. The wall also extends into the Ethereal Plane, blocking ethereal travel through the wall.

optionalfeature.name: Telepathic Contact
entries: {@i Awakened Discipline}
By channeling psionic power, you gain the ability to contact many creatures over long distances.

items: {@b Psychic Focus.} While focused on this discipline, you gain the ability to use your Telepathy class feature with up to two creatures at once. If you don’t have that feature from the psion class, you instead gain it while focused on this discipline.

{@b Missive (1—7 psi)} As an action, you telepathically send a short message of ten words or less to a creature that you know of within 1 mile of yourself. You can increase the number of words in the message by ten per additional psi point spent. The creature hears the message in its mind in the language that it was sent and recognizes you as the sender if it knows you. You are not aware of whether or not the target receives the message, such as if it is not within a mile of you.

{@b Telepathic Relay (3—7 psi; conc., 1 hr.)} As an action, you forge a telepathic link between yourself and two other creatures you can communicate with via telepathy, psychically linking each creature to all the others until your concentration ends. You can increase the number of other creatures you can have psychically linked by three per psi point spent. The psychic link functions identically to your telepathy, but you don’t need to see each other to communicate. Messages within the psychic link are heard equally between all creatures. You can use a bonus action while this ability is active to add a creature that you can communicate with via telepathy to the psychic link or remove a creature other than yourself from the psychic link. Creatures are removed from the psychic link the moment they are outside of your telepathic range.

{@b Mental Message (5—7 psi)} As an action, you telepathically send a short message of twenty-five words or less to a creature that you have telepathically communicated with at some point in the past. The creature hears the message in its mind, recognizes you as the sender, and can answer telepathically in a like manner immediately. You can increase the number of words that you and the target can send each other by five per additional psi point spent. Creatures with an Intelligence score of at least 1 can understand the message. You can send the message across any distance and even to other planes of existence.

{@b Telepathic Link (7 psi)} As an action, you forge a link between yourself and up to eight other creatures you can communicate with via telepathy, psychically linking each creature to all the others for 1 hour. Creatures with Intelligence scores of 2 or less aren't affected by this power. The linked creatures can communicate telepathically through the bond whether or not they have a common language. The communication is possible over any distance, though it can’t extend to other planes of existence.

optionalfeature.name: Telepathic Manipulation
entries: {@i Awakened Discipline}
By channeling psionic power, you gain the ability to control other creatures by substituting your will for their own.

items: {@b Psychic Focus.} While focused on this discipline, the range of your Telepathy class feature increases to 300 feet. If you don’t have that feature from the psion class, you instead gain it while focused on this discipline.

{@b Exacting Query (2 psi)} As an action, you target one creature you can communicate with via telepathy. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target truthfully answers one question you ask it via telepathy. On a successful save, the target is unaffected, and the creature is immune to the effects of this feature for 24 hours. You know whether or not the target succeeded their saving throw. A creature is immune to this ability if it is immune to being {@condition Charmed}.

{@b Occluded Mind (3 psi)} As an action, you target one creature you can communicate with via telepathy. The target must make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, the target believes one statement of your choice for the next 8 hours that you communicate to it via telepathy. The statement can be up to ten words long, cannot be directly harmful, and it must describe you or a creature or an object the target can see. On a successful save, the target is unaffected, and the creature is immune to the effects of this feature for 24 hours. Every time an affected creature witnesses a new piece of evidence that directly contradicts the statement, the creature remakes the save at advantage, ending the effect on a success. On a failure, the creature rationalizes the contradiction in a way that makes sense to them. A creature is immune to this ability if it is immune to being {@condition Charmed}.

{@b Broken Will (5 psi)} As an action, you target one creature you can communicate with via telepathy. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, you choose the target’s movement and actions on its next turn. On a successful save, the target is unaffected, and the creature is immune to the effects of this feature for 24 hours. A creature is immune to this ability if it is immune to being {@condition Charmed}.

{@b Psychic Grip (7 psi; conc., 1 min.)} As an action, you target one creature you can communicate with via telepathy. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw, or it is {@condition Paralyzed} until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends. At the end of each of its turns, it can repeat the saving throw. On a success, this effect ends. On a failure, you can use your reaction to force the target to move up to half its speed, even though it’s {@condition Paralyzed}. The effect immediately ends if the target is further than the range of your telepathy.

optionalfeature.name: Terrakinesis
entries: {@i Wu Jen Discipline}
You attune your mind to seize control of wood and earth.

items: {@b Psychic Focus.} While focused on this discipline, you have advantage on checks made to {@action Climb|THICC}.

{@b Animate Light Weapon (1—7 psi)} As an action, your mind seizes control of a light melee weapon you’re holding. The weapon flies toward one creature you can see within 30 feet of you and makes a one-handed melee weapon attack against it, using your discipline attack modifier for the attack and damage rolls. On a hit, the weapon deals its normal damage, plus an extra {@dice 1d8} force damage per psi point spent on this ability. The weapon returns to your grasp after it attacks.

{@b Animate Heavy Weapon (2—7 psi)} As an action, your mind seizes control of a melee weapon you’re holding. The weapon flies toward one creature you can see within 30 feet of you but greater than 5 feet from you and makes a two-handed melee weapon attack against it, using your discipline attack modifier for the attack and damage rolls. On a hit, the weapon deals its normal damage, plus an extra {@dice 1d8} force damage. You can increase the damage by {@dice 1d8} per additional psi point spent on it. The weapon returns to your grasp after it attacks.

{@b Warp Weapon (2 psi; conc., 1 min.)} As an action, you reach for one weapon held by a creature within your reach. That creature must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw, or the chosen weapon has a penalty to attack and damage rolls equal to your Intelligence modifier until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends.

{@b Warp Armor (3 psi; conc., 1 min.)} As an action, you reach for a nonmagical suit of armor worn by one creature within your reach. That creature must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw, or the armor has a penalty to its AC equal to your Intelligence modifier until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends. An armor’s base AC cannot go below 10 as a result of this feature.

{@b Wall of Wood (3—7 psi; conc., 1 hr.)} As an action, you create a wall of wood, at least one portion of which must be within 60 feet of you. The wall is 60 feet long, 15 feet high, and 1 foot thick. The wall lasts until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends. Each 5-foot wide section of the wall has AC 12 and 15 hit points per psi point spent, and vulnerability to fire damage. Breaking one section creates a 5-foot by 5-foot hole in it, but the wall otherwise remains intact.
{@b Armored Form (6 psi; conc., 1 min.)} As a bonus action, you gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage, which lasts until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends.

{@b Animate Earth (7 psi; conc., 1 hr.)} As an action, you cause an earth elemental to appear in an unoccupied space filled with earth that you can see within 120 feet of you. The elemental lasts until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends, and it obeys your verbal commands. In combat, roll for its initiative, and choose its behavior during its turns. When this effect ends, the elemental disappears. The DM has their stat block.

{@b Wall of Stone (7 psi; conc., 1 hr.)} A nonmagical wall of solid stone springs into existence at a point you choose within 120 feet of you. The wall is 6 inches thick and is composed of ten 10-foot-by-10-foot panels. Each panel must be contiguous with at least one other panel. Alternatively, you can create 10-foot-by-20-foot panels that are only 3 inches thick. If the wall cuts through a creature's space when it appears, the creature is pushed to one side of the wall (your choice). If a creature would be surrounded on all sides by the wall (or the wall and another solid surface), that creature can make a Dexterity saving throw. On a success, it can use its reaction to move up to its speed so that it is no longer enclosed by the wall. The wall can have any shape you desire, though it can't occupy the same space as a creature or object. The wall doesn't need to be vertical or rest on any firm foundation. It must, however, merge with and be solidly supported by existing stone. Thus, you can use this effect to bridge a chasm or create a ramp. If you create a span greater than 20 feet in length, you must halve the size of each panel to create supports. You can crudely shape the wall to create crenellations, battlements, and so on. The wall is an object made of stone that can be damaged and thus breached. Each panel has AC 15 and 30 hit points per inch of thickness. Reducing a panel to 0 hit points destroys it and might cause connected panels to collapse at the DM's discretion. If you maintain your {@status concentration||concentration} on this effect for its whole duration, the wall becomes permanent and can't be dispelled by the Dispel Psionics feature. Otherwise, the wall disappears when your {@status concentration||concentration} is broken.

optionalfeature.name: Third Eye
entries: {@i Nomadic Discipline}
You create a third, psychic eye in your mind, which you cast out into the world. It channels thoughts and knowledge back to you, greatly enhancing your senses.

items: {@b Psychic Focus.} While focused on this discipline, you have {@sense darkvision} with a range of 30 feet. If you already have {@sense darkvision} with that range or greater, increase its range by 15 feet.
{@b Unwavering Eye (2 psi)} As a bonus action, you gain advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) and Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) checks for 1 minute.
{@b Tremorsense (3 psi; conc., 1 min.)} As a bonus action, you gain {@sense tremorsense} with a radius of 30 feet, which lasts until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends.

{@b Piercing Sight (5 psi; conc., 1 min.)} As a bonus action, you gain the ability to see through objects that are up to 1 foot thick within 30 feet of you. This sight lasts until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends

{@b Wandering Eye (6 psi; conc., 1 hr.)} As an action, you create a psychic sensor within 30 feet of you. The sensor lasts until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends. The sensor is {@condition Invisible} and hovers in the air. You mentally receive visual information from it, which has normal vision and darkvision with a range of 30 feet. The sensor can look in all directions. As an action, you can move the sensor up to 30 feet in any direction. There is no limit to how far away from you the eye can move, but it can’t enter another plane of existence. A solid barrier blocks the eye’s movement, but the eye can pass through an opening as small as 1 inch in diameter.
{@b Phasing Eye (7 psi; conc., 1 hr.)} As Wandering Eye above, except the eye can move through solid objects but can’t end its movement in one. If it does so, the effect immediately ends.
{@b Truesight (7 psi; conc., 10 min.)} As a bonus action, you gain {@sense truesight} with a radius of 60 feet, which lasts until your {@status concentration||concentration} ends.
